scripts.dev: npm run build -w @prd-studio/contracts && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @prd-studio/server" "npm run dev -w @prd-studio/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @prd-studio/contracts && npm run build -w @prd-studio/server && npm run build -w @prd-studio/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @prd-studio/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @prd-studio/server && npm run typecheck -w @prd-studio/client
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @prd-studio/contracts && npm run lint -w @prd-studio/server && npm run lint -w @prd-studio/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @prd-studio/contracts && npm run test -w @prd-studio/server && npm run test -w @prd-studio/client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @prd-studio/contracts && npm run test:e2e -w @prd-studio/client
